lines: Wedded in joy by mere brush of Thy lotus-feet —
take me by the scruff, Lord, into Thine own house.
sanskrit_cite: tvatpādapadmasamparkamātrasambhogasaṅginam | galepādikayā nātha māṃ svaveśma praveśaya

lines: My hair dyed red with Thy foot-lotus dust —
when shall I, in boundless frenzy, break into dance?
sanskrit_cite: bhavatpādāmbujarajorājirañjitamūrdhajaḥ | apārarabhasārabdhanartanaḥ syām ahaṃ kadā

lines: Thou my sole Lord — this much alone I beg, ever: dumb, dwelling inside Thee may I be —
never otherwise, O Wise One.
sanskrit_cite: tvad ekanātho bhagavann iyad evārthaye sadā | tvadantarvasatir mūko bhaveyaṃ mānyathā budhaḥ

lines: Ah, nectar-hoard, Master! Ah, sweet Three-eyed!
Ah, tasty Deformed-eyed! — so may I dance, yelling.
sanskrit_cite: aho sudhānidhe svāminn aho mṛṣṭa trilocana | aho svādo virūpakṣety eva nṛtyeyam āraṭan

lines: Eyes half-shut with Thy foot-lotus touch —
may I gape wide, reeling with Thy love-wine's drunkenness.
sanskrit_cite: tvatpādapadmasaṃsparśaparimīlitalocanaḥ | vijṛmbheyabhavadbhaktimadirāmadaghūrṇitaḥ

lines: Mind-mountain on earth, may I dwell anywhere, All —
where that practice runs unbroken, deep-sapped, made of Thy babble.
sanskrit_cite: cittabhūbhṛd bhuvi vibho vaseyaṃ kvāpi yatra sā | nirantaratvatpralāpamayī vṛttir mahārasā

lines: Where Thou standest with the Lady, many-shaped, from palace to gate-tower —
in that town may I dwell.
sanskrit_cite: yatra devīsametas tvam āsaudhādā ca gopurāt | bahurūpaḥ sthitas tasmin vāstavyaḥ syām ahaṃ pure

lines: May Thy sun-rays sport, Lord, till this heart-lotus of mine opens —
for Thy worship.
sanskrit_cite: samullasantu bhagavan bhavadbhānumarīcayaḥ | vikasatveṣa yāvan me hṛtpadmaḥ pūjanāya te

lines: Be gracious, Lord —
that my mind, ever fallen at Thy feet, tasting this and that, melt as wax, run.
sanskrit_cite: prasīda bhagavan yena tvatpade patitaṃ sadā | mano me tattadāsvādya kṣīved iva galed iva

lines: From joy though it blow pot-lids, or from sorrow —
from outward feeling, inward feeling — show plain to me, Master.
sanskrit_cite: praharṣād vātha śokād vā yadi kuṅyād dhaṭād api | bāhyād athāntarād bhāvāt prakaṭībhava me prabho

lines: Without too, within too —
may that ever-oozing be mine: Thy foot-lotus-touch nectar, cool past cool.
sanskrit_cite: bahir apy antar api tat syandamānaṃ sadāstu me | bhavatpādāmbujasparśāmṛtam atyantaśītalam

lines: Dived deep in Thy touch-nectar lake —
O what a joy past joys, leaping all enjoyment — be mine, ever.
sanskrit_cite: tvatpādasaṃsparśasudhāsaraso 'ntarnimajjanam | ko 'py eṣa sarvasambhogalaṅghī bhogo 'stu me sadā

lines: Take the laid offering — passions and the rest, Lord, by me; take, nectarize, and feast —
with lover-folk, together.
sanskrit_cite: niveditam upādatsva rāgādi bhagavan mayā | ādāya cāmṛtīkṛtya bhuṅkṣva bhaktajanaiḥ samam

lines: Ever sated on whole-world food, easy-seated —
Master, take among slaves one grace-glance-instant.
sanskrit_cite: aśeṣabhuvanāhāranityatṛptaḥ sukhāsanam | svāmin gṛhāṇa dāseṣu prasādālokanakṣaṇam

lines: Half-eyed, chewing inner love-wonder —
'bow to me, to Śiva' — worshiping, may I be, even straws.
sanskrit_cite: antarbhakticamatkāracarvaṇāmīlitekṣaṇaḥ | namo mahyaṃ śivāyeti pūjayam syāṃ tṛṇāny api

lines: Though Thy state be won — seeing the world my self-blaze —
by love-sap feastings may I stay unparted.
sanskrit_cite: api labdhabhavadbhāvaḥ svātmollāsamayaṃ jagat | paśyan bhaktirasābhogair bhaveyam aviyojitaḥ

lines: Since naught else is to be longed for, Lord —
Thine — secondless — fullness is but fit.
sanskrit_cite: ākāmkṣaṇīyam aparaṃ yena nātha na vidyate | tava tenādvitīyasya yuktaṃ yat paripūrṇatā

lines: Where 'tis laughed, 'tis danced —
where hates-and-loves are eaten, love-nectar drunk — may I win that foot-place.
sanskrit_cite: hasyate nṛtyate yatra rāgadveṣādi bhujyate | pīyate bhaktipīyūṣarasas tat prāpnuyāṃ padam

lines: That unheard-perfume — Thy-thought-blossoms' scent —
harden in my mind, till ill-habit's stink is eaten.
sanskrit_cite: tat tad apūrvāmodatvaccintākusumavāsanā dṛḍhatām | etu mama manasi yāvann aśyatu durvāsanāgandhaḥ

lines: Where, pray, love among passions —
and where loving 'mid Hara's foot-lotuses? So teach my clash-fond heart its good, Deathless.
sanskrit_cite: kva nu rāgādiṣu rāgaḥ kva ca haracaraṇāmbujeṣu rāgitvam | itthaṃ virodharasikaṃ bodhaya hitam amara me hṛdayam

lines: Roaming yoga-states even, turned from sense-things even —
Thy-thought-wine's frenzy liquifying my heart — only that may I be.
sanskrit_cite: vicaran yogadaśāsv api viṣayavyāvṛttivartamāno 'pi | tvaccintāmadirāmadataralīkṛtahṛdaya eva syām

lines: Speech, mind-thoughts, sense-wrought body-moves —
everywhere, ever, may love-sap run vanguard before me.
sanskrit_cite: vāci manomatiṣu tathā śarīraceṣṭāsu karaṇaracitāsu | sarvatra sarvadā me puraḥsaro bhavatu bhaktirasaḥ

lines: 'Śiva Śiva Śiva' — Thy name muttered without end, Lord —
tasting may I be some great unre-said sap.
sanskrit_cite: śivaśivaśiveti nāmani tava niravadhi nātha japyamāne 'smin | āsvādayan bhaveyaṃ kam api mahārasam apunaruktam

lines: Vast flashing endless knowing-self — dull roads all drunk dry —
ramparts uncounted, knowing-made — may I roam, by Thee honored.
sanskrit_cite: sphuradanantacidātmakaviṣṭape parinipītasamastajaḍādhvani | agaṇitāparacinmayagaṇḍike pravicareyam ahaṃ bhavato 'rcitā

lines: Standing in self-body, clear-shining, everlasting —
naught else avails. Firm be this thought. Yet — Thy foot-lotus dust, O Pure.
sanskrit_cite: svavapuṣi sphuṭabhāsini śāśvate sthitikṛte na kim apy upayujyate | iti matiḥ sudṛḍhā bhavatāt paraṃ mama bhavaccaraṇābjarajaḥ śuceḥ

lines: Something, Lord, sometime flashes in mind —
touchers of Thy foot-sole, where this whole melts — in nectar's lake show me this world, ever.
sanskrit_cite: kim api nātha kadācana cetasi sphurati tad bhavadaṃghritalaspṛśām | galati yatra samastamidaṃ sudhāsarasi viśvam idaṃ diśa me sadā
